newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end up on high cap shares.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end up on high cap shares.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Tuesday, mainly due to gains in two highly capitalised blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index closed 5.2 points up at 849.3, with price gains outnumbering declines by 41 to 29. Blue chips Development Finance rose five rupees to 325, John Keells Holdings 2.50 to 372.50.
"Both scrips, the two most capitalised shares trading in Colombo, are seeing buying because interim profits to June have been good," said a broker who declined to be identified.
